mapper.sql: select id, menu_name, guide_text, image_path, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from wl_qr_config
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0'
and menu_name like concat('%', #{menuName}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by sort_order asc, id asc
where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into wl_qr_config(menu_name, guide_text, image_path, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark) values(#{menuName}, #{guideText}, null, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0', #{remark})
mapper.update: update wl_qr_config set menu_name = #{menuName}, guide_text = #{guideText}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'

update wl_qr_config set image_path = #{newImagePath}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
and image_path is null and image_path = #{expectedImagePath}

update wl_qr_config set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
and image_path is null and image_path = #{expectedImagePath}
